correctness.rationale: Reconstructed full distinct-particle state reduction S/D: exclusion Q=[[−2m,2m],[2(m−1),−2(m−1)]], killed K=[[−2m,2m],[2(m−1),−2m]]. The positive Perron eigenvector h=(sqrt(m/(m−1)),1) has eigenvalue −λ with λ=2m−2sqrt(m(m−1)). Doob ground-state h transform makes BOTH S↔D rates 2sqrt(m(m−1)), hence stationary opposite probability exactly 1/2 and hazard κ=2I_D with centered stationary covariance exp(−2rt), integrated variance t/r−(1−exp(−2rt))/(2r²). The Radon–Nikodym derivative dNC/dEx=h(Xt)/h(X0) exp(λt−∫κ) yields matched-initial path KL rates λ−1 and 2m/(2m−1)−λ; stationary endpoint log-h difference cancels. Both >0 for m>=2 and tend to 1/(4m). Independent direct numerical/algebraic checks at m=2,3,4,5,10,100 confirm eigenpairs, balance and rates, while exact two-state derivation proves all m. Read pinned verifier that reconstructs full labelled matrices for m=2..6, but the stored claim of 601 checks is not itself evidence of the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: Balanced complete bipartite graphs give a canonical solvable model in which excluding collisions and conditioning on survival are distinctly different processes. The exact stationary half-traffic law, hazard correlations and both strictly positive quantitative relative-entropy rates give natural path-space observables not supplied by the general existence/change-of-measure theorem. This is a small-dimensional but fully uniform, motivated quantitative classification; it does not claim a new general Doob theory.
risks: The two-state diagonalization is elementary and could have appeared in an earlier specialized calculation; scientific value is specifically the physically interpretable exact comparison, not the linear algebra alone.

final_claim: For two labeled continuous-time walkers on K_{m,m}, m>=2, directed edge rates 1, the noncollision Doob transform reduces opposite-side occupancy to symmetric two-state rates r_m=2sqrt(m(m−1)), P(D)=1/2, stationary hazard mean 1 and covariance exp(−2r_mt); relative entropy rates against exclusion are λ_m−1 and 2m/(2m−1)−λ_m, λ_m=2m−2sqrt(m(m−1)), both strictly positive and ~1/(4m).
limitations: Balanced K_{m,m} only, exactly two labelled particles, unit edge rates, stationary initialization for covariance/KL, no unbalanced or high-particle extension.
Requires labelled distinct walkers and per-directed-edge jump rate one, and EXACT infinite-horizon Doob conditioning (not finite survival conditioning).
Relative entropies require identical initial distributions for each law pair, specifically numerator stationary initialization.
